scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts *.ts *.js *.json "deployment/*.json" index.html README.md CHANGELOG.md "docs/*.md" ".github/workflows/*.yml"
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts *.ts *.js *.json "deployment/*.json" index.html README.md CHANGELOG.md "docs/*.md" ".github/workflows/*.yml"
scripts.test:recovery: playwright test tests/browser/offline-file.spec.ts tests/browser/linked.spec.ts tests/browser/app.spec.ts tests/browser/automatic-import.spec.ts --grep "actual downloaded|exact reader|link landing|offline saved reader|new passwords require|automatic-import"
